section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the rationale for examining the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) across cultures and states that the present study examined the factor structure of the BAS among Indonesian women and men, including gender and ethnic differences. It also states the expectation that men would report greater body appreciation than women, no expected ethnic differences, and that associations between body appreciation and BMI (expected negative) were examined. The section refers to 'the present study' (no numbered studies such as 'Study 1').
section_summary.evidence_source: To this end, the present study examined the factor structure of the BAS among Indonesian women and men. In summary, the present study examined the factor structure of the BAS among an Indonesian sample, as well as gender and ethnic differences in this context. Finally, we examined associations between body appreciation scores and participant body mass index (BMI), with the expectation of negative relationship, as those who appreciate their bodies may be less likely to binge eat or eat in the absence of hunger.
